newsitem.title: USA: Optronics secures credit line from BankBoston.
newsitem.headline: Optronics secures credit line from BankBoston.

text.p: Optronics International Corp said Tuesday it secured a multimillion-dollar line of credit from BankBoston Corp.
The company, in Chelmsford, Mass., said the credit line gives it access to a substantial pool of funds that can help growth and expansion.

"We have ambitious expansion plans for Optronics International and aggressive development plans for precision imaging products for the worldwide printing and publishing industry," said Edward Chrusciel, executive vice president.
The company was not available for immediate comment concerning specific amounts of the deal.
